result.title: Benchmark for Structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Perovskite Photovoltaics
result.summary: While retrieval-augmented language models increasingly serve as literature assistants in the physical sciences, existing benchmarks evaluate them primarily on qualitative text overlap or through model-based scoring rather than against verified experimental ground truth. In experimental materials disciplines such as perovskite photovoltaics, however, the most critical inquiries are inherently quantitative and aggregate measurements across dozens or hundreds of papers. Here, we present a quantitative question-answering benchmark where all 755 ground-truth answers are computed directly from 45,441 measured device records (40,889 human-curated records through 2021 and 4,552 records extracted from 2022-2026 literature). Benchmarking six retrieval architectures over 158,274 passages from 25,662 papers using an open 14B model on a single 24 GB GPU, standard passage retrieval tops out at 16-23% accuracy (compared to 1.6-6.5% zero-shot). In contrast, equipping the language model with read-only SQL execution over the structured device table elevates accuracy to 51.5% on historical and 50.8% on prospective literature -- a 33.01.8 percentage-point advantage over hybrid text retrieval. Aggregate queries spanning extrema, distributions, and filtered record counts prove virtually unsolvable via text retrieval alone, demonstrating that systematic table extraction is an operational prerequisite for literature-scale quantitative inquiry.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作构建钙钛矿光伏领域的定量问答基准，用 45,441 条器件测量记录生成 755 条标准答案，并比较文本检索与只读 SQL 执行两类架构的准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究面向纯文本表格检索与材料数据库查询，既不涉及 VLM 内部推理状态、视觉证据保留，也不涉及 latent 生成或停止决策，未给出可用于 LVR 的具体方法线索，故排除。
